newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-General Gold sells Ramsgate stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-General Gold sells Ramsgate stake.

text.p: Junior gold company General Gold Resources NL said on Thursday it had sold its 18.1 percent stake in Ramsgate Resources NL to an undisclosed buyer at 10 cents a share, realising A$4.15 million.
Ramsgate is General Gold's joint equal partner in the Mt Monger gold project in Kalgoorlie in Western Australia.
General Gold's managing director, Cliff Harding, said the funds from the sale would be used to reduce debt and to fund an agressive exploration program at Mt Monger.

"Our investment in Ramsgate simply did not fit any longer with our direction as a company, particularly given that the circumstances under which we made the investment in December last year have changed significantly," Harding said.
Westgold Resources NL bid for Ramsgate earlier this year and held 51.5 percent at the close of its offer in August.
Westgold offered a 1-for-1 share swap or a conditional bid of A$4.00 cash and 60 Westgold shares for every 100 Ramsgate shares, which valued Ramsgate at about A$24 million.

Earlier, Westgold said it was not the purchaser of General Gold's stake in Ramsgate. At 2.15 p.m. (0415 GMT), General Gold shares were unchanged at 50 cents and Ramsgate shares were 0.001 cent higher at 10 cents on turnover of 42.03 million shares.
